review: SemiconFab-Next review-2 follow-up fixes: RunStore submit scalability + startup index recovery, delta-safe telemetry backpressure, residual lighting allocations, fail-closed heap gate

submitHistoryScan.finding: Submit() scanned all historical Run files (ReadRuns().SingleOrDefault) for every new idempotency key.
submitHistoryScan.change: Removed the per-key history scan. A one-time per-instance reconciliation rebuilds the idempotency index from Run records; the index is sharded to <data>/idempotency/<scope-prefix>.json (256 shards) so Submit reads/writes only its own shard.
submitHistoryScan.tests: Corrupt unrelated completed Run no longer breaks Submit; shard presence, replay/conflict across restart, lost-shard rebuild, legacy global-index migration and RecoverIndexes repair are covered (backend 168/168).

benchmark.note: first Submit includes the one-time O(R) reconciliation + shard rebuild (runs at worker startup via RecoverIndexes, not per Submit).

pendingIndexRecovery.finding: A crash between Save(run) and WritePendingIndex could leave a new Run undiscovered for up to 10 minutes (PendingIndexRebuildInterval).
pendingIndexRecovery.change: SimulationWorker.StartAsync now calls FileRunStore.RecoverIndexes(), which rebuilds both indexes authoritatively from Run records before the worker claims anything. The 10-minute fallback rebuild remains.
pendingIndexRecovery.tests: RecoverIndexes_restores_a_run_missing_from_the_pending_index (TryClaim null before recovery, lease immediately after); RecoverIndexes_repairs_both_indexes_from_run_records (missing-run entries pruned, RUNNING lease/expiry preserved).

telemetryDeltaBackpressure.finding: The single pending latest-wins slot replaced frames, so future sparse/delta frames could permanently lose entity updates during Worker backpressure.
telemetryDeltaBackpressure.change: New mergeTelemetryFrames(base, incoming) merges samples by entityId (newer value wins, entity order preserved, new ids appended, identity fields from the newest frame). TelemetryRuntime merges into its bounded pending slot instead of replacing; full snapshots still converge to latest; no queue.
telemetryDeltaBackpressure.tests: 3 new tests: pure merge semantics; deferred-reply F1(equipment-0 in flight)->F2(equipment-1),F3(equipment-2),F4(equipment-3) flushes one frame carrying all updates (sequence 4, states running/down/idle/maint); full-snapshot backpressure still collapses to one frame. docs/realtime-protocol.md section 5.4 documents the contract.

lightingResidualAllocations.finding: Even with the reused 384-float packet, repack() allocated a wrapper object per frame and writeUbo() allocated temporary arrays per material UBO write.
lightingResidualAllocations.change: Replaced the cached wrapper object with packedCount/packetReady scalars; ambient and fabLightInfo uniforms are written with direct scalar assignments. Uniform values, toggle invalidation, public APIs and shader code are unchanged.
lightingResidualAllocations.tests: New byte-stability test (repeated frames, locals/ambient toggles, repack before next UBO); lite-lighting 9 tests.

heapGateFailClosed.finding: The 60 Hz heap budget silently passed when heapGrowthMb was null/NaN ('no evidence is not growth').
heapGateFailClosed.change: A configured heap budget now fails closed on a missing/non-finite metric ('Renderer heap growth is not finite'); dev/default behavior is byte-compatible and failure ordering is unchanged.
heapGateFailClosed.tests: Gate unit tests 13/13 (null/undefined/NaN/Infinity, 40 MB fail, 6 MB pass, dev missing pass, explicit custom threshold fail-closed, ordering).

knownBoundaries: The first Submit after process start pays the intentional one-time O(R) reconciliation + shard rebuild (about 2.0 s at 10,000 historical Runs / 256 shard writes); this runs on the worker-startup path (RecoverIndexes), not per Submit. Steady-state Submit is independent of history outside its shard.
Per-instance reconciliation means a non-crash write loss in the same long-lived instance is repaired on the next new store instance or explicit RecoverIndexes, not by an arbitrary later new key.
Legacy global idempotency-index.json migration is authoritative from Run records; entries whose Run record is unreadable/missing are dropped (documented recovery tradeoff).

Browser gate numbers are single-machine headless Chrome baselines and the 60 Hz profile numbers remain environment-dependent; the dev run in this round recorded a single 41.5 ms p99 outlier while the stricter 60 Hz run recorded p99 16.6 ms.
TwinContent still rerenders on liveToolStates/statusFeed (~10 Hz SSE) and research time (~10 Hz during playback); further isolation needs a FabViewport data-flow change.

The packed static structure (1,721,856 B generated module) must be committed with its change; drift is covered by tests/static-structure-pack.test.ts and `node tools/pack_static_structure.mjs --check` (not wired into scripts/verify.ps1).
WGSL fault-lamp pulse, GPU compute airflow and SharedArrayBuffer remain deferred pending GPU A/B or COOP-COEP infrastructure.
